meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Shaadi ke liye budget mein **silk-blend, Banarasi-style, georgette ya ready-to-wear sarees** achhi rahengi. Online options ko budget ke hisaab se aise dekhein:

- **₹300–₹700:** Meesho par Banarasi-style, Kanjeevaram-look, Paithani-look aur festive sarees mil jaati hain; kai options ₹250–₹650 ke beech listed hain.[2][4][5]
- **₹700–₹1,500:** Libas ki silk-blend sarees zyada polished look deti hain—printed, woven aur embroidered options lagbhag ₹759–₹1,259 se mil rahe hain.[6]
- **₹1,500–₹3,500:** Better-quality silk blend, organza ya heavy embroidery wali saree chun sakti hain; Flipkart par bridal saree options is range mein milte hain.[1]
- **₹4,000–₹6,000:** Agar aap bride hain, to Dola silk ya bridal silk saree zyada rich lagegi; kuch options lagbhag ₹4,175–₹5,800 ke hain.[10]

**Best choices:**
- **Bride:** Red/maroon Dola silk, Banarasi silk ya Kanjeevaram-look saree  
- **Sister/friend:** Bottle green, wine, royal blue ya magenta silk-blend saree  
- **Wedding guest:** Georgette, organza ya sequin saree—lightweight aur comfortable  
- **Day wedding:** Pastel pink, peach, yellow ya mint  
- **Night wedding:** Maroon, emerald green, navy blue ya purple  

**Meri practical recommendation:** ₹800–₹1,500 ka silk-blend saree budget aur appearance dono ke liye best balance deta hai. Order karne se pehle customer photos, blouse-piece length, saree fabric, return policy aur delivery date zaroor check karein. Meesho par bahut low-price options milte hain, lekin quality seller-to-seller kaafi badal sakti hai.[2][3]
